text:
tori_support: Hey team — Escalation from AcmeOps. Tool call returns 400 for their file-converter tool. They pasted the args from PowerShell and it looks like bad JSON/escaping + trailing comma. Customer blocked in prod.
tori_support: POST /v1/tools/call -> response 400
{
  "error": "ToolArgsSchemaValidationError",
  "message": "Invalid tool args: JSON parse error at char 128"
}
tori_support: Customer pasted this curl from Windows PowerShell (they ran in PS 7):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-raw "{\"tool\":\"file-converter\", \"args\": {\"path\": \"C:\\Users\\acme\\invoices\\2025\\q1.csv\", \"format\": \"parquet\", }, }"
```
tori_support: Note the trailing commas after "format" and the outer object. Also Windows backslashes and double quotes — common pain point.
sam_eng: Thanks — can you repro locally? quick question: is this via hosted API or Dedicated?

tori_support: Hosted API (customer on free trial). They tried SDK then curl. SDK escaped same way. We asked for raw request body from server logs, got the JSON parse error with offset. Attached snippet from parser: "JSONDecodeError: Extra data after closing object at 0x80"

ivan_runtime: Likely double-encoding/clientside quoting issue + trailing comma. Many parsers (js/serde) will error on trailing commas. PowerShell's string interpolation sometimes wraps quotes weirdly; also backslashes may become "\\" sequences if they single-quote vs double-quote incorrectly.

sam_eng: Repro plan: try same curl from PowerShell and from bash. If PowerShell is the culprit, we should add a KB entry and update SDK docs. Also we can improve the error message to include "trailing comma" when parse fails near a comma.

ivan_runtime: I can add a small change to the args parser: when JSON decode fails, run a quick heuristic that checks for trailing commas (regex like ,\s*[}\]]) and unescaped backslashes in string literals; then return 400 with hint: "Malformed tool args: check trailing commas and escaping (PowerShell). Recommend using @file.json or --data-binary with file."

eva_support: Can we offer customer a workaround now? Suggest asking them to put args in a file and send via `--data-binary @args.json` (or use our SDK which sends proper encoding) — and include example file contents.

ops-bot: NOTE: Customer reported blocked job at 2025-11-02T14:07Z, affected 1 user, severity: high

[tori_support pinned a message]

sam_eng: I'll create a minimal repro and open a PR for the error hint. Tori — can you get the exact request_id from their log so we can match in our gateway logs?

tori_support: Request id sent: rqd_01G7KJ3H8PZ2A9X1. Sent to you in DM. I'll reply to customer with workaround and ETA for fix. :thumbsup:

ivan_runtime: Quick patch plan: add heuristic hints + unit tests. If we see repeated similar reports, we can consider a server-side tolerant parser that accepts trailing commas for tool args only (but need product approval).

eva_support: Follow-up: mark as escalated -> engineering. CC'ing account team for billing impact if they remain blocked >24h.

sam_eng: Sounds good. Action items: sam -> repro + PR for hint; ivan -> patch error message; tori -> communicate temporary workaround and collect any more request_ids.

tori_support: Thanks — I'll close the loop with AcmeOps after they confirm workaround works. If they still hit issues, we'll ask for the raw bytes of the request body and curl command they used. :white_check_mark:
